DIAGNOSIS READY: Boerhaave Syndrome (Esophageal Perforation)

The Chest X-ray confirms free mediastinal air, which is pathognomonic for esophageal rupture following severe vomiting. Given the history of forceful retching and subsequent chest pain, this is a medical emergency. Please prepare the patient for immediate surgical consultation and broad-spectrum antibiotics.
